meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: Claude 查询 Azure 订阅中各类资源的配额上限与当前用量,算出剩余可用量,并在配额不足时帮你提交配额提升申请。主要用于部署规划和区域选择前的容量确认。
howto.when: 当用户提到配额、用量、容量等词,要求在部署或选区前验证资源上限,或遇到配额超限要提额时触发。

say.text: 我订阅现在的 vCPU 配额还剩多少?
say.note: 查询 vCPU 相关配额的上限、用量和可用量。

say.text: 把我的 standardDSv3Family 配额提高到 500,帮我提交。
say.note: 提交配额增加后查询审批状态。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Azure CLI to check quota (maximum deployable resources) and current usage in a subscription, reports the remaining available capacity, and can submit quota-increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions quotas, usage, or capacity, asks to validate resource limits before deployment or region selection, or requests a quota increase.

say_en.text: Check all quotas and current usage for Microsoft.Compute in eastus.
say_en.note: Outputs a table with limit, usage, and available per quota.

say_en.text: How many vCPUs are still available in my subscription?
Raise my standardDSv3Family quota to 500 and submit the increase request.
say_en.note: Submits via az quota update and shows request status.
